title: 3.0.0.1 Problems: Small Screen, Prediction of active Insulin, reuse Profile Switch
symptom: On a small screen (Atom XL), some treatments cannot be deleted in the Treatments tab without rotating the screen. The prediction of active insulin is missing (previously the whole curve could be seen). When reusing a profile switch (even with same profile or changed values), an error occurs and it sets -6 hours. Long-pressing to expand the overview takes long to load.
fix: For the treatment removal issue, the 'Remove' buttons were moved to the options menu in PR #1362 to improve screen usage. For the graph rescale on long press, a PR #911 was made to fix it, but it still had issues in history browser. The profile switch bug was acknowledged as a bug to investigate, but no fix is stated.
evidence_quote: the treatment "Remove" buttons have been moved to the options menu in PR #1362 this makes the result in better screen usage.
